_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger cases all supply (or clearly imply) a reference ad to copy plus the user's own product. Negatives must route elsewhere: generating-ad-videos (a product ad from scratch, no reference video), generating-ugc-videos (a creator's own take), generating-image-ads (a still ad), generating-videos (general video / animate a photo), analyzing-products (a bare URL).
trigger_keywords: make this ad for my product

cases.query: clone this ad for my energy drink, here's the video
recreate this competitor's video ad with my sneaker instead
make an ad just like this one but for my skincare serum
copy this video ad and swap in my coffee bag
remake this ad with my product, keep the same structure
same ad but with my watch as the product
replicate this ad's pacing and shots for my headphones
make this ad for my product — here's the reference clip and my bottle
make a cinematic commercial for our smartwatch with an actor presenting it
create a premium product-hero video for our watch, no people on screen
make a UGC video of a creator reviewing our serum
make a static image ad for my coffee bag with a discount badge
make a video of waves crashing on a beach
animate this product photo with a slow push-in
what's on this product page https://example.com/item
what's the weather in Tokyo today
